design_rationale:
WORKLOG — checking_fees_overdraft_and_disputes, task 1 (Wendell Pruitt, Interest Checking, overdrawn)

STEP 0. DIFFICULTY PRE-CHECK, ASSET LEDGER AND SCOPE CLAIM
Snapshot at entry. Already occupied by task 0: the extended policies checking_ext_fee_schedule_correction,
checking_ext_dispute_credit_reversal and checking_ext_closure_payout, and the task tools
post_fee_schedule_correction_961f83a2, post_dispute_credit_reversal_956f6db8 and confirm_closure_payout_0546356c —
that is, the bank-error ground of a refund entry, the take-back side of the dispute policy, and the closure of an
account. Claimed by this task, and disjoint from all of it: checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source,
checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit, checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion and
checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief, with the tools authorize_overdraft_protection_source_1d4e232c,
post_dispute_provisional_credit_b16208c2, convert_account_tier_569988a7 and post_overdraft_courtesy_relief_64b96dbf.
Nothing is left over: the two tasks together claim all seven extended policies of the charter and all seven task
tools, with no overlap in either list. The two refund-ground policies are the charter's own two grounds and are
genuinely different tests — task 0's corrective entry asks what the published schedule produces for a run of
charges and puts back the excess on the bank-error ground, while this task's goodwill entry accepts that the
charges were correctly taken and asks how much of them the bank will give back as a gesture, held down by the
shortfall and by an episode ceiling.

Draw, taken by code before any of the tree or the computations was designed:
  .venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py \
      env/regional_retail_bank/tasks/checking_fees_overdraft_and_disputes --task 1
  {"task": 1, "key": "regional_retail_bank/checking_fees_overdraft_and_disputes/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3,
   "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 4, 4]}
Task 1 therefore has exactly three prerequisite problems and the multiset of its factor counts is {6, 4, 4, 4}:
checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief carries 6, and checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source,
checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit and checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion carry 4 each. The design was
fitted to the draw.

DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal: "I would like you to put right the overdraft charges on my checking account." Scored
core parameter: relief_amount, the goodwill entry. The customer never mentions anything else, and the rule of
checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief places three separate states in front of its own result, each stated in its
own sentence and each false when the call opens: the account's record must name an active savings account of the
owner as the source the bank may draw on (the field is empty); every temporary credit owed on a claim still being
looked into must stand posted (a claim from 2025-08-25 still reads submitted, its tenth business day has passed and
no credit entry exists); and the account must stand on the tier its relationship balance supports (the record says
Interest Checking while the relationship balance reaches the premier threshold). Resolving all three changes the
answer twice over and unlocks it once: the temporary credit moves the shortfall the relief is held down to from
746.65 to 96.40, the conversion moves the goodwill share from the standard to the deep relief share, and the naming
of the source is the eligibility the goodwill rule places on its own result. Breadth: the four computations between
them read this account's whole ledger, both of the owner's savings accounts, his certificate and twelve months of
his card ledger, and eighteen declared ladders sit on that evidence.

STEP 0 CARD 1 — BASE-INVARIANT CARD (per exact write subject)
checking_set_overdraft_link (the protection source, step 10). Governing base policy:
checking_evt_overdraft_protection_transfer.
  same_owner (authorization, system_record, pre_action, correlated on savings_accounts.savings_account_id bound to
    the call's overdraft_link_savings_account_id): the Premier Money Market carries the same customer_id as the
    checking account. Satisfied.
  savings_active (state, same correlation): that savings account reads active. Satisfied. The Statement Savings is
    active too, which is why the order candidates are tried in decides the answer rather than eligibility alone.
  No time gate applies to this subject.
checking_provisional_credit (the temporary credit, step 12). Governing base policy: checking_evt_electronic_dispute.
  notice_window (time). Starting business event: "the disputed item posted". Anchor:
    checking_transactions.posted_date. Duration: variants.dispute_notice_window_days, 120 on every tier. Counting
    rule, verbatim: "Count calendar days with the day after the disputed item's posted_date as day 1; the notice
    qualifies when notice_date is on or before that posted_date plus dispute_notice_window_days." Direction:
    not_after. Boundary: inclusive. The item posted 2025-08-22 and notice was given 2025-08-25, three days later.
    Negative case: an item posted 2025-04-26 gives 2025-08-24, one day short of the notice. Boundary case: an item
    posted 2025-04-27 gives exactly 2025-08-25 and still qualifies.
  credit_due (time). Starting business event: "the owner gave notice". Anchor: checking_disputes.notice_date.
    Duration: variants.provisional_credit_business_days, 10. Counting rule, verbatim: "Business days are Monday
    through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays; count business days with the first business day after
    notice_date as day 1; the credit is due when the frozen date is on or after the business day that ends the
    count." Direction: not_before. Boundary: inclusive. Notice was given Monday 2025-08-25; Labor Day 2025-09-01 is
    a Federal Reserve holiday and is not counted, so the count runs Tue 26, Wed 27, Thu 28 and Fri 29 August, then
    Tue 2, Wed 3, Thu 4 and Fri 5 September, then Mon 8 September, and the tenth business day is Tuesday 2025-09-09,
    two days before the frozen date of 2025-09-11. Negative case: on 2025-09-05 only eight business days had run and
    the desk would have to wait. The account opened 2019-03-05, far outside the 30 calendar days of new-account
    treatment, so the ten-business-day count applies rather than the twenty-business-day one.
  submitted_only (state): the claim reads submitted at the frozen date. Satisfied.
  one_credit (dedup, object_bindings {checking_dispute_id: checking_dispute_id}, duplicate_filters event_type
    checking_provisional_credit): no temporary credit entry exists on the account. Satisfied.
checking_change_product (the conversion, step 14). Governing base policies: checking_product_change and
checking_agg_relationship_balance.
  must_be_active (state, correlated on checking_accounts.checking_account_id): the account reads active.
  target_entry_gate (authorization, correlated on customers.customer_id bound to the call's customer_id): Premier
    Checking's entry gate asks an age of at least 18 — the owner was born 1971-11-30 and is 53 — and fewer than two
    accounts of that tier already held, of which he holds none. The opening deposit is expressly excepted for a
    conversion. Satisfied.
  checking_agg_relationship_balance carries no eligibility of its own and is therefore carried as policy_scope: it
    fixes the basis a relationship balance is measured on, which this write reads.
checking_fee_refund (the goodwill entry, step 16). Governing base policies: checking_evt_fee_refund and
checking_evt_electronic_dispute.
  eligible_fee_code (authorization, correlated on checking_transactions.checking_txn_id bound to source_item_id):
    the charge the entry is recorded against carries fee_code extended_overdraft, the fifth entry of
    courtesy_eligible_fee_codes. Satisfied.
  courtesy_window (time). Anchor: checking_transactions.posted_date; duration
    variants.courtesy_refund_window_days, which is 90 on the tier in force at this step, Premier Checking. The
    charge posted 2025-08-29, 13 calendar days before the frozen date. Negative case: a charge posted 2025-06-12
    gives 2025-09-10, one day short. Boundary case: 2025-06-13 gives exactly 2025-09-11 and still qualifies.
  courtesy_limit (authorization, correlated on checking_transactions.customer_id bound to customer_id): Premier
    Checking allows three goodwill refunds in a rolling 365 days; one entry with adjustment_reason courtesy_waiver
    stands, posted 2025-05-20. One is below three. Satisfied.
  account_active (state): the account reads active; it went negative on 2025-08-22, 20 calendar days before the
    frozen date, short of the 30 days after which base restricts it. Satisfied.
  refund_once (dedup, object_bindings {source_item_id: source_item_id}): the only refund-kind entry on the account
    points at the overdraft charge of 2025-04-18, not at the charge this entry stands against. Satisfied.
  checking_evt_electronic_dispute is carried as policy_scope: it governs the dispute-final ground, which this
    goodwill entry is not.
Automatic clauses of base checked against this seed: the maintenance fee is waived every cycle because the owner's
relationship balance on base's own measure — money market 12000.00 plus certificate 5000.00, with a negative
checking balance counted as zero — is 17000.00, above Interest Checking's 15000.00 waiver threshold, so no
maintenance charge is owed or seeded; statement delivery is electronic and the paper statement charge is therefore
not owed; the long-overdraft charge that the 7-day trigger makes due for this episode is already posted on
2025-08-29, so that clause is discharged and once_per_episode blocks a second; the restriction clock stands at 20
of its 30 days, so no restriction is owed; the account had activity on 2025-09-05, so dormancy is far off; interest
is credited at cycle close and the frozen date sits mid-cycle, so none is owed now.

STEP 0 CARD 2 — BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target object of the goodwill entry: the long-overdraft charge of 25.00 posted 2025-08-29, correlated by
checking_transactions.checking_txn_id into the new entry's source_item_id. Rows that enter the relief pool: the
overdraft charges of 2025-04-18, 2025-07-03 and the two of 2025-08-22, the returned-item charge of 2025-08-22 and
that long-overdraft charge — every charge inside the six-month relief window. Row excluded: the overdraft charge of
2025-02-14, which the window leaves out and which is the near-miss a careless reader sums in. The goodwill entry of
2025-05-20 is a settled row: it refunded the 2025-04-18 charge in full, so that charge cannot be refunded again,
and the entry is also the one that puts the rolling-year count at one. Target object of the temporary credit: the
foreign card item of 615.25 posted 2025-08-22, named by the claim record as the debit it was raised about and
carried into the new entry's source_item_id and the claim's own reference. Row excluded: the foreign card item of
210.00 posted 2025-03-12, outside the two-month claim window and belonging to no claim. Target object of the
protection source: one of the owner's two active savings accounts, correlated by savings_accounts.savings_account_id
into the account's overdraft protection source field. Target object of the conversion: the checking account itself.

STEP 0 CARD 3 — PROBLEM-TREE CARD
  root: checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief (post_overdraft_courtesy_relief_64b96dbf, owner=agent)
     <- checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source (authorize_overdraft_protection_source_1d4e232c, owner=user)
     <- checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit (post_dispute_provisional_credit_b16208c2, owner=agent)
     <- checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion (convert_account_tier_569988a7, owner=agent)
Edge 1, kind state_gate, gate checking_accounts.overdraft_link_savings_account_id, form state. Prerequisite
sentence, verbatim from the root's own rule: "Goodwill relief on overdraft charges is granted only once the
account's record names an active savings account of the owner as the source the bank may draw on to cover items."
Four-point test: (1) "only once" joins this policy's own result, the goodwill relief, to what it waits on; (2) the
side it waits on is a record-visible state — a savings account of the owner standing in the account's protection
source field — with no action, performer or tool named; (3) no tool name, no policy id, no code token; (4) "only
once ... an active savings account of the owner" is exactly the edge's condition, no wider and no narrower. Exactly
one write of this difficulty brings that state about: authorize_overdraft_protection_source_1d4e232c is the only
tool that touches that field, and checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source is the only policy whose result is a
protection source. Derivation: the sentence names a state; the account lookup shows the field empty; the savings
lookup shows two active accounts of his; the rule of checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source says a checking
account "may name one of the owner's own savings accounts as the protection source the bank draws on" and that "the
owner names it in person" — one action, and it is the owner's. Seed evidence it is false at the opening:
initial_state.checking_accounts.<account>.overdraft_link_savings_account_id is empty while
initial_state.savings_accounts.<money market>.status and .<statement savings>.status both read active.
Edge 2, kind value_input, gate claim_credits_posted, a real compute binding of the root, form state. Prerequisite
sentence: "The goodwill relief is worked out only after every temporary credit owed on a claim still being looked
into stands posted to the account." Four-point test: (1) "only after" joins the root's own result to what it waits
on; (2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state, a temporary credit entry standing on the account; (3) no
tool, id or code token; (4) its scope, claims still being looked into whose credit has fallen due, is the edge's
condition exactly. Exactly one write brings that state about: post_dispute_provisional_credit_b16208c2 is the only
tool that creates an entry of that kind. Derivation: the claim lookup shows one claim reading submitted with a
notice date of 2025-08-25; the activity lookup shows no temporary credit entry; the rule of
checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit says the bank "puts a temporary credit onto the account" once the credit
has fallen due — one action, one reading. Seed evidence: initial_state.checking_disputes.<claim>.dispute_status =
submitted, .notice_date = 2025-08-25, and no row of the account carries event_type checking_provisional_credit, so
the claim credits posted binding evaluates to 0.00.
Edge 3, kind value_input, gate relief_share, a real compute binding of the root, form state. Prerequisite sentence:
"The goodwill relief is settled only once the account stands on the tier its relationship balance supports." Four-
point test: (1) "only once" joins the root's own result to what it waits on; (2) the side it waits on is the
record-visible state of the tier written on the account against the relationship balance the records show; (3) no
tool, id or code token; (4) the strength is a hard requirement and the scope is exactly the tier the relationship
reaches. Exactly one write brings that state about: convert_account_tier_569988a7 is the only tool that rewrites
variant_name. Derivation: the account lookup shows Interest Checking; the savings, certificate and card lookups
give a relationship balance of 26000.00, above the premier threshold; the rule of
checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion says an account "is carried on the tier its relationship balance
supports, and where the record shows it on a lower tier the bank converts it" — one action, one reading. Seed
evidence: initial_state.checking_accounts.<account>.variant_name = Interest Checking while
initial_state.savings_accounts.<money market>.current_balance = 12000.00 and
initial_state.cd_certificates.<certificate>.principal_balance = 5000.00.
Topological order: the three prerequisites in any order, then the root. The declared order is the protection
source, the temporary credit, the conversion, the goodwill entry. Parallel edges: proved commuting in
order_uniqueness by an actual run of two orders — none of the three reads anything another writes, and the tier
parameter the temporary credit does read, the overdraft fee for each item, is 35.00 on Interest Checking and on
Premier Checking alike. Per-edge deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the temporary credit moves the
scored relief_amount from 96.40 to 120.00; skipping the conversion moves it from 96.40 to 80.00; skipping the
naming leaves the scored figure at 96.40 but removes the eligibility the root's own rule places on its result and
leaves the terminal state without the goodwill entry and with an empty protection source field — which is why that
edge is declared a state gate and not a value input.
Customer's own write: authorize_overdraft_protection_source_1d4e232c is declared @tool(owner="user"); the agent
unlocks it at action 9 and the simulator runs it at action 10. The in-person semantics are real: what is being
authorised is the bank reaching into the owner's own savings, and base's same_owner gate is what makes it his
affair. It completes on the spot under the same frozen clock.

STEP 1 — POLICIES WRITTEN, AND THE OVERRIDES DECLARED
checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source. base_policy_refs: checking_evt_overdraft_protection_transfer. overwrite
[]: base says which savings accounts may be named and this policy says which of them is named, so evaluating the
same quantity in the same world does not put them in conflict. trigger state_due: with no customer calling, an
account that has been paid into overdraft and names no protection source already owes one at reconciliation.
checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit. base_policy_refs: checking_evt_electronic_dispute. overwrite: one entry
superseding "The provisional credit amount is the dispute's claimed_amount, but never more than the disputed item's
amount." with "The temporary credit is the claimed total taken at the credited share and rounded half-up to the
cent, with the charge offset added to it." Base would credit 615.25; this policy credits 650.25 — different in the
same world, so the declaration is required. That clause carries no eligibility condition, so no gate is retired.
trigger state_due: the credit falls due by the clock whether or not the owner calls.
checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion. base_policy_refs: checking_agg_relationship_balance and
checking_product_change. overwrite: two entries against the aggregate policy — the sentence naming the basis as the
customer's deposit balances across checking, savings and certificate holdings is replaced by the four-component
basis, and the sentence "Credit card balances, auto loan balances and safe deposit box rentals never count." is
replaced by the card component sentence. Base's basis would give 17000.00 here and this policy's gives 26000.00, so
both declarations are required; neither clause contains an eligibility condition and the aggregate policy has none,
so nothing is retired. trigger state_due: the account owes its tier at reconciliation, not on request.
checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief. base_policy_refs: checking_evt_fee_refund and
checking_evt_electronic_dispute. overwrite: one entry superseding "A fee is refunded in full, never in part" with
this policy's own sentence about the goodwill relief being held down to the smallest of three figures. Base would
put back the whole of a charge; this policy puts back 96.40 across a pool, so the declaration is required. Note
that task 0's corrective policy supersedes a different clause of the same base sentence, the amount clause "whose
amount equals that fee's amount", and each is scoped to its own refund ground — base itself separates the two
grounds, so the charter gives one answer to each situation. trigger on_request: no goodwill entry falls due on its
own; it arises only because the owner asks.
Two-way sweep, rule -> compute_basis -> compute, done binding by binding for all four policies; every binding that
reads the world, aggregates, chooses a tier, crosses a category, caps or rounds quotes its rule sentence verbatim,
and the reverse sweep found a binding for every promise each rule makes. Semantics pinned where a second reading
was possible: in the goodwill rule the three figures are named and the word "smallest" fixes which is taken, so
there is no guessing about the order of the two holdings-down; the acting base of the goodwill share is named as
"the charges in the relief pool" and not a subtotal; the rounding moment is named at the end and nowhere else. In
the conversion rule the four components are each defined on their own base and the sentence "The four components
are put together by taking the largest single component of the deposit, certificate and checking components alone"
names both the operation and the set it acts on, so the card component's exclusion in the middle tier is explicit
rather than implied.

STEP 1 — FACTOR CARD (the drawn counts: 6, 4, 4, 4)
checking_ext_overdraft_courtesy_relief (6)
  goodwill_share_level, parameter, cross-difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: the deep relief share, on the
    tier in force allowing three goodwill refunds in a rolling year and a premier money market balance of 12000.00.
    Baseline: the modest relief share, giving 60.00.
  relief_pool_basis, method, cross-difficulty card. Tier taken: the overdraft, returned-item and long-overdraft
    charges inside the window added together, 200.00. Baseline: the largest single overdraft charge, giving 21.00.
  shortfall_measure, method. Tier taken: the whole of the money the entries leave the account below zero, 96.40.
    Baseline: half of it, giving 48.20.
  episode_ceiling_level, parameter, cross-difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: the wide episode ceiling of
    400.00, which does not bite. Baseline: the tight episode ceiling of 80.00, which does, giving 80.00.
  relief_entry_rounding, method. Tier taken: to the cent. Baseline: whole five-dollar steps, giving 95.00.
  relief_window_length, parameter, multi-source. Tier taken: the long relief window of six months. Baseline: the
    standard relief window of one month, giving 78.00. The near-miss lives here: the overdraft charge of
    2025-02-14 is visible in the same lookup and is excluded by the six-month window alone.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 10.00, against a gold of 96.40.
checking_ext_dispute_provisional_credit (4)
  claimed_total_basis, method, cross-difficulty card. Tier taken: only the foreign card items inside the two-month
    claim window, 615.25. Baseline: every foreign card item whenever posted, 825.25, giving 860.25. Near-miss: the
    210.00 item of 2025-03-12.
  credited_share_level, parameter, cross-difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: the whole of the claimed
    total. Baseline: half of it, giving 342.62.
  charge_offset_level, parameter, cross-difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: the tier's overdraft fee for each
    item, 35.00. Baseline: no offset, giving 615.25.
  temporary_credit_rounding, method. Tier taken: to the cent. Baseline: five-dollar steps, giving 650.00.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 415.00, against a gold of 650.25.
checking_ext_relationship_tier_conversion (4)
  deposit_component_share, parameter, cross-difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: the whole of the money
    market balance, 12000.00. Baseline: half of it, giving Interest Checking.
  certificate_component_share, parameter, cross-difficulty cd, multi-source. Tier taken: the whole of the
    certificate principal, 5000.00. Baseline: nothing at all, giving Interest Checking.
  component_assembly_basis, method, cross-difficulty card. Tier taken: all four components added, 26000.00.
    Baseline: the largest single component of the first three, 12000.00, giving Everyday Checking.
  checking_component_basis, method. Tier taken: the credits taken in over the three-month deposit window, 7400.00.
    Baseline: the deposits less its paid items where that stands above zero, which is nothing here, giving Interest Checking.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: Everyday Checking, against a gold of Premier Checking.
checking_ext_overdraft_protection_source (4)
  required_cover_level, parameter, cross-difficulty card, multi-source. Tier taken: the light cover requirement of
    250.00. Baseline: the full cover requirement of 25000.00, under which no source is named.
  cover_reserve_level, parameter, cross-difficulty savings, multi-source. Tier taken: no reserve at all. Baseline:
    the full cover reserve of 13000.00, under which no source is named.
  usable_cover_measure, method, cross-difficulty cd. Tier taken: the whole of each balance less the reserve.
    Baseline: the minimum cover share of each balance, 240.00 and 68.00, under which no source is named.
  candidate_order, method. Tier taken: the money market first. Baseline: the statement savings first, which names
    the Statement Savings account instead.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: no source at all, against a gold of the Premier Money Market.
Every tier value is a tier parameter of the charter or one of the policy's own declared params; no base boundary
was weakened to make room for any of them.

STEP 3 — WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS
Six payroll credits and three interest credits give the account its shape and feed both the reconciliation and the
three-month deposit window; the three inside the window are exactly the 7400.00 the checking component rests on, and
the three outside it are what a careless reader adds in. Six rent checks and ten card and direct debits carry the
account down to where the August items overdraw it. The two foreign card items are the claim's subject and its
near-miss. The five overdraft charges are spread across 2025-02-14, 2025-04-18, 2025-07-03 and twice on 2025-08-22
precisely so that the relief window decides which count: delete the February charge and relief_window_length stops
biting. The returned-item charge and the long-overdraft charge are what the relief pool's top tier adds, and the
long-overdraft charge is also the charge the entry is recorded against, chosen because it is uniquely the most
recently posted of the pool. The goodwill entry of 2025-05-20 is doing three jobs at once: it is the rolling-year
count the rounding ladder reads, it is what keeps the courtesy limit below the tier's allowance, and it is the row
that shows the 2025-04-18 charge cannot be refunded twice. The two savings accounts are the two candidates the
protection source ladder chooses between — delete the statement savings and candidate_order stops biting. The
certificate and the twelve card payments are the cross-product evidence that eight of the eighteen ladders rest on.
Cache design check: checking_accounts.ledger_balance is kept exactly equal to the reconciled sum of the seeded
entries, -746.65, so no stale figure is used as a trap; the difficulty comes from reconciling at handling time.
Automatic-clause check: see the base-invariant card.

STEP 4 — THE PERSONA
Voice: apologetic, unhurried, plain-spoken; a man asking for a hand rather than arguing. Volunteered at the
opening: his name, his mobile number, that August got away from him, that a card went through when it should not
have, that the account has been underwater since, and the request itself. Each points at a seeded row — the August
items, the negative-since date, the charges. Given only when asked: date of birth, Social Security last four, ZIP,
email, the year he first banked with PCB, the shape of his pay and rent, and the fact that he holds both the older
savings account and the money market. Explicit cannot-answer branch: he knows no reference numbers at all, so every
reference number in gold comes from a lookup return; and asked which savings account to use he explicitly refuses
to choose, which leaves the choice with the rule rather than the caller. Passive reactions, each tied to something
the agent says: he agrees when the bank's need to draw on his savings is explained; he completes the step when it is
handed to him; he asks for a figure to be re-checked if it sounds thin, without offering one of his own; and he
closes once told the money is back on the account. Nothing in the text names any prerequisite problem, the claim,
the tier or any computed value, and his last reaction answers the last gold action and asks for nothing beyond it.

user_scenario:
Wendell Pruitt is fifty-three, a facilities supervisor for Guilford County Schools, and he has banked with Piedmont Crescent since before his daughter was born. He is unhurried and a little embarrassed, the sort who apologises for taking up time, but he is also plainly out of patience with his checking account. He starts by giving his name and the mobile number 3365550176 without being asked, then explains that August got away from him, a card went through when it should not have, and the account has been underwater since. What he wants is simple enough in his words: I would like you to put right the overdraft charges on my checking account. He says he knows some of them are his own fault and he is not accusing anybody; he is asking for a hand, not an argument, and he has no figure in mind at all.

He will give whatever the desk needs to be sure it is him. Asked for his date of birth he gives 1971-11-30. Asked for the last four of his Social Security number he gives 1163. Asked for his ZIP code he gives 27403. His email and the year he first banked with Piedmont Crescent he will also give if either is asked for, though he has to think about the year. He does not know a single reference number for anything and says so with a laugh if the agent asks; the checking account is the one his pay goes into.

He is content for the desk to do whatever needs doing on the account and does not want it explained line by line: sort it out and tell me where I stand, is how he puts it. If the agent explains that the bank needs him to name one of his own savings accounts as the one it may draw on when something would overdraw the checking account, he says that is fine and that it is his money either way. Asked which of his savings accounts to use, he will not choose: he says use whichever one the bank's own rules point to, he is not going to second-guess it. When the agent tells him the step is ready for him and hands it across, he takes it and completes it himself.

Things he says only when asked: that the pay deposit lands at the end of each month, that the rent check is the biggest thing that goes out, and that he does still have the savings he opened when he joined the bank as well as the money market. If the agent reads him a figure and it sounds smaller than he hoped, he says only that he thought there was more to it than that and asks whether it has been checked against the account; he will not press further and offers no number of his own.

Once the agent tells him the money has gone back onto the account, he is satisfied. He says that is a weight off, thanks the agent for being straight with him, and ends the call there. He asks for nothing more.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The temporary credit write posts a 650.25 entry with the dispute_provisional ground, so the claim credits posted binding becomes 650.25 and the shortfall standing falls from 746.65 to 96.40, which is the figure the goodwill relief is held down to.

edges.condition: The tier written on the checking account is the one the owner's relationship balance reaches, rather than a lower one.
edges.policy_source: The goodwill relief is settled only once the account stands on the tier its relationship balance supports.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At 2025-09-11 the account reads Interest Checking while the owner's money market of 12000.00, certificate of 5000.00, three months of payroll credits of 7400.00 and 16000.00 of card payments put his relationship balance at 26000.00, above the premier threshold of 25000.00. The tier on the record is therefore lower than the one the relationship reaches, and Interest Checking allows only two goodwill refunds in a rolling year where the goodwill share's top tier asks for three.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The conversion write rewrites the tier to Premier Checking, which allows three goodwill refunds in a rolling year, so the goodwill share binding moves from the standard relief share to the deep relief share and the relief before holding down rises from 80.00 to 120.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites hang in parallel off the root and none of them reads anything another writes, so they may be taken in any order and the terminal state is the same. Proved by running the gold writes in the declared order and in the order conversion, temporary credit, naming: the naming step writes only the overdraft protection source field, which neither of the other two computations reads; the temporary credit writes a temporary credit entry and the claim state, and the conversion's own computation reads only deposit entries, paid items, the money market, the certificate and the card ledger, none of which that entry belongs to; the conversion writes only the tier, and the temporary credit's computation reads only the tier's overdraft fee for each item, which is 35.00 on Interest Checking and on Premier Checking alike. Both runs give a protection source of the Premier Money Market, a temporary credit of 650.25 and a tier of Premier Checking, and the same terminal rows.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the naming step leaves the checking account's overdraft protection source field empty, so the goodwill rule's own eligibility on its result does not hold and no goodwill entry may be granted at all; the terminal state differs by the whole of the 96.40 entry and by the field on the account row. The scored relief amount itself is unchanged at 96.40, which is exactly why the edge is declared a state gate rather than a value input.

Skipping the temporary credit leaves the claim credits posted binding at 0.00 and the shortfall standing at 746.65, so the goodwill relief is no longer held down by it and the scored relief_amount recomputes to 120.00 instead of 96.40; the terminal state also loses the 650.25 credit entry and leaves the claim reading submitted.

Skipping the conversion leaves the account on Interest Checking, which allows two goodwill refunds in a rolling year rather than three, so the goodwill share falls from 0.60 to 0.40 and the scored relief_amount recomputes to 80.00 instead of 96.40; the terminal state also keeps the old tier on the account row.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names none of the three prerequisite problems. Wendell asks only that the overdraft charges on his checking account be put right; he never mentions the claim he filed, the temporary credit owed on it, the tier his account sits on or his relationship balance, and he drops no hint that anything has to be settled first. His only contribution about a prerequisite is a passive response after the agent has raised it: 'If the agent explains that the bank needs him to name one of his own savings accounts as the one it may draw on when something would overdraw the checking account, he says that is fine and that it is his money either way', and when asked which account he refuses to choose. If the agent never finds a prerequisite he neither reminds nor presses, and his closing reaction follows whatever figure is written.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_overdraft_courtesy_relief_64b96dbf writes unconditionally: its body is a ctx.create of the goodwill entry followed by a ctx.update of the balance, with no read of the overdraft protection source field, no count of temporary credit entries and no look at the tier; it cannot return an error on a business ground. post_dispute_provisional_credit_b16208c2 and convert_account_tier_569988a7 are the same shape. Calling the goodwill tool first would succeed and simply write the wrong figure onto an account with no protection source; the consequence of skipping a prerequisite shows up only in the terminal hash.
